name: Macro Pad
creator: NanoKVM Community
desc: Multi-page touchscreen macro pad for NanoKVM with up to nine buttons per page.

NANOKVM_MCP_KEY.label: NanoKVM MCP API key
NANOKVM_MCP_KEY.description: API key from Settings > AI > MCP Service.

NANOKVM_MCP_URL.label: NanoKVM MCP endpoint
NANOKVM_MCP_URL.description: Leave unchanged for the local device MCP service.

MACRO_PAD_CONFIG.label: Button configuration
MACRO_PAD_CONFIG.description: Optional. The buttons.json content as one-line JSON, or an http(s) link to a JSON file. Leave empty to use the bundled buttons.

MACRO_PAD_MODIFIER.label: @MOD key
MACRO_PAD_MODIFIER.description: Optional. mac (Command) or windows/linux (Control). Overrides the modifier from the button configuration.
